title: Rike-Per Kremmer
world: Present-day Norway, in a long inland valley where Rich Per owns half of everything. Just below his big modern house, an old stone mill house stands by a fast river; a couple of dozen kilometres downstream is a second old mill with a wooden waterwheel under the floor. The chest is a small, polished oak box with a heavy brass lock, its seams sealed with tar. Per's letter is a sealed white envelope. The thieves' hideout is a shabby smallholding deep in a spruce forest, and the young couple's smallholding lies up under a bare ridge. Far away runs a great, wide river with no bridge, and above it a fortress-like house of grey concrete and dark glass is built into the mountain. The three feathers are long, shining golden feathers.
palette: A raw, grey November: low cloud and fog along the rivers, wet asphalt and gravel, black spruce, the last yellow birch leaves plastered to the ground, and dusk by four in the afternoon with orange street lights and warm lit windows. In the concrete house: cold blue-white light, black glass and the glint of gold.

cast.name: Møllergutten
cast.description: Gutten som ble solgt som nyfødt og satt ut på elva i ei tjæret kiste, og som vokser opp på kverna lenger ned til en rolig, sterk ung mann som snur alle fellene til lykke.
cast.look: A sturdy, broad-shouldered young man of about nineteen with a round, open, honest face, a button nose, friendly pale-blue eyes, a wide, warm grin and short, tight strawberry-blond curls. He wears a faded dove-grey baseball cap with a scarlet brim, a white T-shirt under an open oatmeal canvas work jacket, faded jeans and scuffed brown work boots.
cast.portrait: Background: the old stone mill by the foggy river.

cast.name: Rike-Per
cast.description: En kald og beregnende forretningsmann som eier halve dalen, behandler folk som eiendeler og prøver å kjøpe seg ut av spådommen, helt til grådigheten sender ham ut i elva.
cast.look: A tall, bony businessman of about sixty with a long, horsey face, a jutting chin, a sharp hooked nose, small, darting, greedy grey eyes, a thin mouth, long bushy salt-and-pepper sideburns and slicked-back black hair streaked with grey, with a sharp widow's peak. He wears an expensive long wine-red wool overcoat over a charcoal suit, a green-and-gold striped silk tie, polished black shoes, a heavy gold signet ring and a chunky gold watch.
cast.portrait: Background: his glossy living room with a big steel safe.

cast.name: Pers datter
cast.description: Oppvokst under farens kontroll og giftet bort i all hast etter et forfalsket brev, men det er hun selv som sier ja, og ekteskapet blir veien ut av farens grep.
cast.look: A tall, willowy young woman of about twenty-three with a long neck, a narrow face with a delicate chin, a small straight nose, soft brown eyes under pale brows, pink cheeks and a calm, direct gaze. Her thick auburn hair hangs in one long plait down her back, tied with a white band. She wears a midnight-blue wool jumper with a red-and-white knitted band at the hem and cuffs, dark jeans, brown leather boots and a small round silver pendant.
cast.portrait: Background: the smallholding under the bare ridge.

cast.name: Laksekongens datter
cast.description: Tatt av Dragen av Dybenfart for mange år siden og holdt fanget i et hus av glass og stål, gir hun møllergutten styrkedrikken og lurer dragen til å røpe svarene.
cast.look: A small, quick-witted young woman of about twenty-four, very pale from years indoors, with a round face, a pointed little chin, a small straight nose, bright dark eyes that miss nothing and a wry, lopsided smile. Her dark-brown hair is cut short in a cap of springy curls, held back by a thin silver hairband set with one pearl. She wears a long, expensive turquoise silk dress with wide sleeves and soft grey slippers.
cast.portrait: Background: the dark glass wall of the concrete house.

cast.name: Dragen av Dybenfart
cast.description: En eldgammel drage som bor i et prisbelønt hus av betong og mørkt glass, bygd inn i fjellet. Han vil ha nattero, og den som har de tre fjærene fra halen hans, kan få hva han vil.
cast.look: An ancient, heavy, pot-bellied dragon about twice as tall as a man, only just able to squeeze through a wide door, who walks upright on short, thick hind legs with big blunt claws. He has bumpy plum-purple scales dulled with age, a pale lavender belly, small leathery wings far too small for him, a long snout with round nostrils trailing smoke, big heavy-lidded amber eyes and a row of rust-orange spikes down his back. His long tail ends in exactly three long, shining golden feathers.
cast.portrait: Background: his enormous low bed in front of the dark glass wall.

cast.name: Fergemannen
cast.description: En gammel, krokrygget mann som bærer folk over den brede elva på ryggen, dømt til å gjøre det til noen avløser ham.
cast.look: A small, wiry, very old man, bent almost double with a back as crooked as a fish hook, yet strong as an ox. He has a wrinkled nut-brown face, a sharp beak of a nose, bright little black eyes under bushy snow-white eyebrows, a toothless grin, no beard, and thin white hair tied at the back in a stubby pigtail. He wears a battered straw hat, a faded sea-green anorak with patched elbows and grey work trousers rolled up above the knee, and goes barefoot.
cast.portrait: Background: the wide river with no bridge, in fog.

places.name: the Glass Hall
places.look: A vast, cold room inside a fortress-like house of grey concrete and dark glass built into a mountainside. One wall is dark glass looking out over a river valley, the others are raw grey concrete, and the polished black stone floor shines like a mirror. An enormous low bed with charcoal-grey covers and a dark gap beneath it stands at the far end, with a long grey sofa by the glass wall, a steel dining table, steel drawers and an old sword with a worn hilt on the concrete.

cover.prompt: At night in the Glass Hall, the Dragon sleeps in his enormous low bed, a thread of smoke rising from his nostrils, and his long tail spills over the edge and across the mirror-shiny floor towards the viewer, ending in three long, shining golden feathers. From the dark gap under the bed, the Miller's Lad peers out at the feathers, holding his breath. Through the glass wall, the dark valley and the river lie far below.
cover.caption: Møllergutten må hente tre fjær fra halen til Dragen av Dybenfart.
cover.alt: Om natten sover dragen i ei diger seng, og halen med tre skinnende gullfjær ligger over det blanke gulvet. Under senga kikker møllergutten fram og holder pusten.

illustrations.anchor: Per la en konvolutt til.
illustrations.prompt: Night inside an old domed observatory on a hill outside town, the dome's slit open to a sky full of stars and a big old brass telescope pointing up through it. Three old stargazers in rumpled cardigans, a tall bald man, a small woman with a white bun and a thin man with a grey ponytail, sit behind a cluttered desk. Rich Per, still in his buttoned overcoat and without a smile, slides a second fat brown envelope across the desk next to the first. The small woman raises her eyebrows.
illustrations.caption: Per la en konvolutt til. «Se ordentlig etter», sa han.
illustrations.alt: Tre gamle stjernekikkere sitter bak et rotete skrivebord i et observatorium. Rike-Per skyver en ny, tykk konvolutt over bordet, og gjennom kuppelen ser man stjernene.

illustrations.anchor: Da mølleren kom inn, sa Per det samme til ham.
illustrations.prompt: In the bare kitchen of an old stone mill house on a grey evening, a young miller in a flour-dusted sweatshirt sits at the table, staring down at the tabletop with his hands clasped. Opposite him, Rich Per waits patiently in his overcoat, one finger resting on a thick envelope. By the window, the miller's young wife, her dark hair in a ponytail, holds their newborn baby wrapped in a blanket tight against her chest, her face frightened.
illustrations.caption: Mølleren satt lenge og så på bordplata.
illustrations.alt: En ung møller sitter ved kjøkkenbordet og stirrer ned i bordplata. Rike-Per venter med fingeren på en tykk konvolutt, og ved vinduet holder mora den nyfødte gutten tett inntil seg.

illustrations.anchor: Før det lysnet, bar han kista ned til elva.
illustrations.prompt: Before dawn on a grey, cold riverbank, with thick fog lying over the dark water. Rich Per kneels on the wet grass in his expensive long overcoat and sets a small, polished oak chest with a heavy brass lock out on the current, his hands still resting on its lid for a moment. His face is calm and cold. Downstream, the faint outline of old mill buildings shows through the fog.
illustrations.caption: Han satte kista forsiktig ut på strømmen og holdt den et øyeblikk.
illustrations.alt: I grålysningen kneler Rike-Per på elvebredden i den dyre frakken sin og setter ei lita, blank eikekiste ut på det mørke vannet. Tåka ligger tett over elva.

illustrations.anchor: De ringte politiet, for det gjør man.
illustrations.prompt: In the cramped, warm kitchen of the second mill, an old miller and his small old wife stand close together: he is big and stooped, with a grey beard, bushy eyebrows and a flour-dusted cap, and she wears a hand-knitted cardigan and cradles a beautiful baby boy with a wisp of strawberry-blond hair. Around them crowd two police officers in black uniforms taking notes, a child-welfare caseworker clutching a folder, and a young journalist holding up a camera. The open oak chest stands empty on the table.
illustrations.caption: De ringte politiet, for det gjør man.
illustrations.alt: Et gammelt møllerpar står på kjøkkenet med en liten gutt i armene. Rundt dem står to politifolk, en saksbehandler fra barnevernet og en journalist med kamera, og den åpne kista står tom på bordet.

illustrations.anchor: Pers datter vokste opp.
illustrations.prompt: In a big, glossy living room, a nervous young man in his best shirt perches on the edge of a white leather sofa, clutching a bunch of flowers, while a sleek lawyer in a black suit leans across the glass coffee table towards him with a thick folder open. Rich Per stands behind the lawyer with his arms folded. In the doorway, Per's Daughter leans against the frame with her arms crossed, rolling her eyes.
illustrations.caption: Hver gang en gutt kom i nærheten av henne, ordnet Per det.
illustrations.alt: En nervøs ung mann med blomster sitter ytterst på en skinnsofa, mens en advokat spør ham ut og Rike-Per står bak med armene i kors. I døra himler Pers datter med øynene.

illustrations.anchor: Det første han gjorde, var å kjøre ned langs elva til den kverna.
illustrations.prompt: A foggy grey morning outside the old stone mill by the fast river. The Miller's Lad, flour on his cap and sleeves, carries a fifty-kilo flour sack on his shoulder as if it weighed nothing, humming. The old miller, now bent and frail, with a grey beard and a flour-dusted cap, watches from the doorway. In the gravel yard, Rich Per has just stepped out of a big, dark, expensive car and studies the Miller's Lad through narrowed eyes.
illustrations.caption: Gutten var nitten nå. Han bar femtikilos melsekker på skulderen og nynnet.
illustrations.alt: Møllergutten bærer en tung melsekk på skulderen utenfor kverna, og den gamle mølleren ser på fra døra. På gårdsplassen har Rike-Per steget ut av en stor, mørk bil og mønstrer ham.

illustrations.anchor: «Noe sender man ikke på melding», sa Per.
illustrations.prompt: At dusk in the puddled car park of a shabby roadside motel at the edge of a great, dark spruce forest, Rich Per has just handed the Miller's Lad a sealed white envelope. The Miller's Lad holds it up with a puzzled frown, his phone in his other hand, its screen glowing. Rich Per answers with a thin, patient smile. A big dark car is parked behind them, and a narrow path leads away into the trees.
illustrations.caption: «Noe sender man ikke på melding», sa Per.
illustrations.alt: På parkeringsplassen ved et veimotell i skogkanten har Rike-Per gitt møllergutten en igjenlimt konvolutt. Møllergutten ser undrende på den med mobilen i den andre hånda.

illustrations.anchor: Småbruket var tilholdssted for tolv tyver.
illustrations.prompt: Midnight in the small, shabby bedroom of a smallholding deep in the forest. The Miller's Lad sleeps across a made-up bed in his clothes. Twelve thieves in hoodies, work jackets and beanies crowd into the room around the bed, one of them shining a torch. Another, a lanky thief with a grey goatee, has lifted the cap off the sleeper's face and reads the letter from it with raised eyebrows. Through the window, a van loaded with outboard motors stands in the yard.
illustrations.caption: Småbruket var tilholdssted for tolv tyver.
illustrations.alt: Møllergutten sover på tvers over ei seng. Tolv tyver står rundt ham, og en av dem har løftet capsen og leser brevet i lyset fra en lommelykt.

illustrations.anchor: Dattera leste brevet to ganger.
illustrations.prompt: In the bright, expensive kitchen of the big house, Per's Daughter stands very still by the kitchen island, reading the letter for the second time. The Miller's Lad waits in the doorway, holding his cap in both hands. Behind her, her mother, a thin, neat woman in her sixties with a silver bob and pearl earrings, talks into a phone with a pen poised over a long list.
illustrations.caption: Dattera leste brevet to ganger. Så så hun på gutten.
illustrations.alt: Pers datter står på kjøkkenet og leser brevet for andre gang. Møllergutten venter i døra med capsen i hendene, og bak henne snakker mora i telefonen.

illustrations.anchor: Presten spurte, og dattera sa ja.
illustrations.prompt: Inside a small white wooden country church, with white bows on the pews and two petrol-station bouquets on the altar. Per's Daughter, pale as paper in a simple white dress, says her yes loudly to the young priest, and beside her the Miller's Lad, in a borrowed dark suit straining over his arms, stares at the priest. At the end of the front pew sits the bride's mother, a thin, neat woman with a silver bob, glancing back at the church door. Seven guests smile stiffly behind her.
illustrations.caption: Dattera sa ja. Hun sa det høyt, så det kunne høres helt hjem.
illustrations.alt: I en liten, hvit kirke sier Pers datter ja i en enkel hvit kjole, og ved siden av står møllergutten i en lånt dress som strammer over armene. Mora sitter på første benk og ser seg over skulderen.

illustrations.anchor: «Det er vel og bra at du har fått dattera mi», sa han til møllergutten.
illustrations.prompt: The muddy yard of a small farm up under a bare ridge on a grey November day, beside a red barn and an old tractor. Rich Per has just climbed out of his big dark car and stands stiff with rage, pointing a bony finger at the Miller's Lad. The Miller's Lad stands calmly in his work jacket, and Per's Daughter stands on the farmhouse steps beside him, looking long at her father.
illustrations.caption: «Men skal du beholde henne, må du til Dragen av Dybenfart.»
illustrations.alt: På gårdsplassen på småbruket står Rike-Per stiv av sinne og peker på møllergutten. Møllergutten står rolig, og Pers datter ser lenge på faren sin fra trappa.

illustrations.anchor: «Da trengs det flaks», sa Vannkongen.
illustrations.prompt: In the huge, gleaming kitchen of a grand estate, the Water King, a short, stout man of about sixty with a long braided brown beard, in a mustard-yellow cashmere sweater and a gold watch, holds up a glass jug of murky brown well water and lowers his voice, glancing at the door. The Miller's Lad, a rucksack on his back, leans in to listen. Through the window lies a white-walled courtyard with a splashing fountain.
illustrations.caption: «Det er ikke noe jeg vil ha i avisa.»
illustrations.alt: En liten, tettvokst mann med langt, flettet skjegg holder opp en mugge med grumsete brunt brønnvann og senker stemmen. Møllergutten lener seg fram og lytter.

illustrations.anchor: «Da trengs det flaks», sa Hotelldronninga
illustrations.prompt: Evening in the big steel kitchen of an old mountain hotel, steam rising from the pots and one cook in whites at the stove. The Miller's Lad sits at the end of a steel counter with a plate of food. The Hotel Queen, a tall, elegant woman of about sixty with a long neck, black hair piled high in a tall bun and a lemon-yellow suit with a white silk collar, bends towards him, holding up an empty key ring with a worried, slightly embarrassed look.
illustrations.caption: Hotelldronninga hadde mistet gullnøklene sine.
illustrations.alt: På et stort hotellkjøkken sitter møllergutten med en tallerken mat. Ei høy, elegant dame med oppsatt svart hår bøyer seg mot ham og holder opp en tom nøkkelring.

illustrations.anchor: «Det har aldri vært snakk om båt», sa den gamle.
illustrations.prompt: A great, wide river with no bridge on a grey day, the current running hard. The Ferryman strides through the water up to his waist with the Miller's Lad riding on his crooked back, as steady as if he were walking on a pavement, while the Miller's Lad clings on, astonished. On the far bank, high on a steep slope, a fortress-like house of grey concrete and dark glass is built into the mountain.
illustrations.caption: Han gikk like støtt som på et fortau.
illustrations.alt: Den gamle fergemannen går gjennom den strie elva med vann til livet og møllergutten på ryggen. Høyt over den andre bredden ligger et hus av betong og mørkt glass, bygd inn i fjellet.

illustrations.anchor: Hun hentet ei lita flaske fra en skuff og trykket den inn i hånda hans.
illustrations.prompt: In the Glass Hall, the Miller's Lad strains with both hands at the old sword on the concrete wall, but it won't budge. The Salmon King's Daughter, pale and very still in her silk dress, has taken a small glass bottle from a steel drawer and presses it into his hand, looking at him seriously. His reflection shows in the mirror-shiny black floor.
illustrations.caption: «Ta en slurk av denne.»
illustrations.alt: Møllergutten drar i det gamle sverdet på betongveggen, men det rikker seg ikke. Den bleke unge kvinnen i silkekjole trykker ei lita flaske inn i hånda hans.

illustrations.anchor: «Her lukter det kristen manns bein!» sa dragen.
illustrations.prompt: The Glass Hall at nightfall. The glass walls tremble as the Dragon squeezes in through the doorway, only just fitting, a smell of burning trailing after him, his nostrils flared as he sniffs the air suspiciously. The Salmon King's Daughter stands by the steel table, her face blank and innocent. Under the enormous bed at the far end of the room, the Miller's Lad lies flat in the shadow, holding his breath.
illustrations.caption: «Her lukter det kristen manns bein!» sa dragen.
illustrations.alt: Dragen presser seg inn gjennom døra så glassveggene skjelver, og snuser mistenksomt. Den unge kvinnen står stille ved bordet, og under den store senga ligger møllergutten og holder pusten.

illustrations.anchor: «Nei, er det nå igjen! Hva er det nå, da?» sa dragen.
illustrations.prompt: Night in the Glass Hall, lit only by a cold blue glow from the valley through the glass wall. The Dragon has reared up in his enormous bed, furious and sleepless, smoke pouring from his nostrils and his amber eyes blazing. On the long grey sofa by the glass wall, the Salmon King's Daughter sits up with an apologetic face. Under the Dragon's bed, the Miller's Lad lies in the dark with wide eyes, listening.
illustrations.caption: Nå var han så sint og søvnløs at han var nær ved å fly i flint.
illustrations.alt: Dragen har reist seg i den store senga, rasende og søvnløs, og røyken står ut av nesa hans. Den unge kvinnen sitter oppe på sofaen, og under senga ligger møllergutten og lytter.

illustrations.anchor: Så lot hun ham sove i fred.
illustrations.prompt: Grey dawn light spreads through the glass wall of the Glass Hall. The Miller's Lad stands holding up three long, shining golden feathers, breathing hard, and the Salmon King's Daughter, the colour coming back into her face, stares at them with a hand over her mouth. Outside, the river valley lies in mist. Only the two of them are in view.
illustrations.caption: Før det lysnet, hadde gutten de tre fjærene.
illustrations.alt: I morgengryet står møllergutten og holder opp tre skinnende gullfjær. Den unge kvinnen ser på dem med hånda for munnen.

illustrations.anchor: Laksekongen sa ingenting på lenge.
illustrations.prompt: On the front steps of a modern glass house at the tip of a headland, with a bronze salmon sculpture by the gate, the Salmon King, an elderly, clean-shaven man with bushy silver curls and a crinkled face, in a turquoise quilted vest over a white shirt, holds the Salmon King's Daughter tight with his eyes closed and won't let go. The Miller's Lad waits a few steps below with his cap in his hand, smiling quietly, two bulging sports bags at his feet.
illustrations.caption: Laksekongen sa ingenting på lenge. Så holdt han rundt henne og ville ikke slippe.
illustrations.alt: På trappa til et glasshus ytterst på et nes holder Laksekongen, en gammel mann med sølvgrå krøller, rundt dattera si og vil ikke slippe. Møllergutten står nedenfor med capsen i hånda og smiler.

illustrations.anchor: Så kjørte gutten rett hjem til småbruket oppunder åsen
illustrations.prompt: The muddy yard of the small farm under the ridge on a grey afternoon. The Miller's Lad has just driven home in a car pulling a trailer piled high with gold and silver, gleaming so brightly it lights up the yard. Per's Daughter stands beside him, smiling. Rich Per holds the three long, shining golden feathers, but he isn't looking at them at all: he stares at the trailer with huge, greedy eyes.
illustrations.caption: Nå var han mye rikere enn Rike-Per.
illustrations.alt: Møllergutten har kjørt hjem med en henger full av skinnende gull og sølv. Pers datter står ved siden av ham, og Rike-Per holder de tre gullfjærene, men stirrer grådig på hengeren.

illustrations.anchor: Fergemannen gikk ut i elva.
illustrations.prompt: Midstream in the great river on a cold, grey day. Rich Per has just come up out of the icy water, coughing and furious, his expensive long overcoat spreading out around him and turning black. The Ferryman stands in the current beside him and looks at him with a face like stone. On the near bank behind them, two big lorries, three trailers and a huge cool bag wait by the water's edge.
illustrations.caption: Per kom opp igjen, hostende og rasende.
illustrations.alt: Midt i elva kommer Rike-Per opp av det kalde vannet, hostende og rasende, med frakken bredt ut rundt seg. Fergemannen står i strømmen og ser på ham med et ansikt som en stein.
